items.title: Eddie Marshall interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: I mean Burt Bacharach wrote beautiful songs for Dionne

ctx.x: Did you stop doing that because it got repetitious or was it just kind of came to —?

Well two reasons I stopped. It was really good music, I mean Burt Bacharach wrote beautiful songs for Dionne, “Anyone That Had a Heart” and great tunes. I mean really, musically, rhythmically, everything, I loved playing that music. Then she recorded “Do You Know the Way to San Jose.” So she was laughing about it, I didn’t do any recordings, we were the road band. And she brings this song to the rehearsal and said, “You guys are going to die after this.” We recorded this and it was really doing great in some…
